name: @cloudsforge/admin-api
description: The operator BFF. Cross-service operator actions behind an approval queue that refuses self-approval, a tamper-evident hash-chained audit mirror, feature flags and broadcasts. Supersedes the frozen platform/services/nimbus admin proxies, whose audit is a log line and whose pay proxy is deleted outright now the gateway handles CORS.

scripts._test: --test-concurrency=1 is required, not a preference: every database test file truncates this service's tables between cases, and node:test runs FILES in parallel by default. A TRUNCATE takes an AccessExclusiveLock, so one file's reset deadlocks against another file's inserts (40P01). Cases within a file already run in order.

_localDependencies: Every sibling takes 'link:', not 'file:'. A 'file:' path PACKS the dependency, and each of
these packages declares files: ['dist'] with a publishConfig that points main/types at dist/.
Packing therefore installs a package whose exports resolve to a dist/ that has not been built,
while its 'main' in the working tree still says src/index.ts. 'link:' symlinks the checkout in
place, so the working-tree manifest is the one that is read and the package keeps using its own
